title: Unit button
description: A fully rounded pill in one regular weight: solid black (white inside dark bands) or a hairline outline. A small chevron sits after the label; on hover it slips away and an arrow slides in from the left while the fill softens to 80% or the outline darkens, over 0.425s on a sharp ease-out.
notes: solid uses the primary token, so inside a `dark` island it turns white with black text
md is 36px tall on phones and 42px from 1024px; sm is the 40px header pill
name: unit-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: filled pill in the primary colour · outline: hairline pill on the page

props.name: size
props.description: md: 36px on phones, 42px from desktop (section CTAs) · sm: 40px at every width (header)

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link
